---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Markdown Documentation Instructions

- Keep documentation concise and actionable.
- Match nearby heading style and table format.
- Prefer relative links for repo files.
- Verify new internal links point to existing files.
- Avoid long pasted content when a short summary and link are enough.
- Keep examples concrete and task-oriented.
- For methodology docs, distinguish required gates from optional guidance.
